tools.name: describe_design
tools.description: Overview of the loaded design: counts, kinds, clock domains, property keys, available checks. Call this first.

input_schema.description: No arguments: the entry point an agent calls first.
input_schema.title: DescribeDesignInput

tools.name: list_components
tools.description: List components, optionally filtered by kind.

kind.description: Filter by component kind, e.g. 'initiator', 'router', 'target', 'observer'. Omit to list every component.
kind.title: Kind

tools.name: get_component
tools.description: Get one component by id, with its links and bandwidth balance.

component_id.description: Exact component id (not its display name). Use search to resolve a name into an id.
component_id.title: Component Id

tools.name: list_links
tools.description: List links, optionally filtered by src and/or dst component id.

src.description: Keep only links whose src is this component id.
src.title: Src

dst.description: Keep only links whose dst is this component id.
dst.title: Dst

tools.name: get_link
tools.description: Get one link by id, flagging unresolved endpoints and clock crossings.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Ranked search over ids, names, kinds, endpoints and properties; each hit reports which field matched and how.

query.description: Text to look for in ids, display names, kinds, link endpoints and property values.
query.title: Query

types.description: Restrict results to components or links.
types.title: Types

case_sensitive.description: Off by default: 'sram' must find the component whose display name is 'SRAM_L2'.
case_sensitive.title: Case Sensitive

search_properties.description: Also match property keys and values, e.g. 'AXI4' or 'cd_noc'.
search_properties.title: Search Properties

tools.name: get_neighbors
tools.description: Direct peers of a component, following link direction.

component_id.description: Component whose direct peers you want.
component_id.title: Component Id

direction.description: 'out' follows links where the component is src, 'in' where it is dst.
direction.title: Direction

tools.name: find_path
tools.description: Shortest directed path between two components, with latency sum and bandwidth bottleneck.

max_hops.description: Give up beyond this many links.
max_hops.title: Max Hops

tools.name: validate_design
tools.description: Run consistency checks (topology, clock domains, bandwidth, source duplicates) and return a structured verdict.

checks.description: Subset of check names to run (see describe_design.checks_available). Omit to run them all.
checks.title: Checks

min_severity.description: Lowest severity to report: 'error' only, 'warning' and above, or 'info' (everything).
min_severity.title: Min Severity

tools.name: update_property
tools.description: Change one property. Previews by default (persist=false): returns the diff and the validation impact without touching the file.

element_id.description: Id of the component or link to modify.
element_id.title: Element Id

prop_path.description: Dotted path inside the element's 'properties' object, e.g. 'qos' or 'bandwidth_mbps'. Structural fields (id, src, dst, kind) are not reachable and cannot be changed.
prop_path.title: Prop Path

persist.description: False (default) previews the change: you get the diff and the validation impact, and the design file is left untouched. Set True only when the preview is what you want.
persist.title: Persist

force.description: Persist even if the change introduces new error-severity validation issues. Without it such a write is refused.
force.title: Force

tools.name: set_link_endpoint
tools.description: Retarget a link's src or dst to an existing component; the only structural edit exposed, same preview-and-validate policy.

role.description: Which end of the link to move: 'src' (origin) or 'dst' (destination).
role.title: Role

component_id.description: Existing component id to point at. A non-existent id is refused, since that is exactly the defect this repairs.
component_id.title: Component Id

persist.description: False (default) previews the change and leaves the file untouched.
persist.title: Persist

force.description: Persist even if the change introduces new error-severity issues.
force.title: Force

tools.name: export_report
tools.description: Short design report as text, markdown or json.
